product_description: The unboxed Coco Bear PRO kettle shown in the supplied reference: ivory-white rounded base, clear glass jug partly filled with clear water, thick ivory handle on the right, metallic collar below the jug rim, transparent lid with ivory bear-shaped knob, black rounded front control panel with Coco Bear logo, dual temperature readouts and original buttons. Keep exactly the supplied product design, shape, colors and visible controls. Do not change into a blender or coffee machine. The kettle stands on the worktop, removed from the reference transport box. Do not invent new controls or functions.

clips.background: A cozy contemporary home kitchen at night, a generous clear pale oak worktop in the foreground, dim warm under-cabinet lighting and a softly blurred window with night sky. Product foreground is well lit and easy to inspect. No baby, crib or bedroom bed.
clips.presenter: A fictional adult Vietnamese woman about 30 years old, black hair loosely tied back, teal long-sleeve lounge shirt, friendly and natural, wearing simple casual clothes. Position her at the far left behind the worktop and beside the kettle, waist-up view. Product is the main subject.

clips.background: A bright modern home kitchen in daylight, a cream stone island worktop with generous clear space, natural window light, softly blurred oak cupboards and a distant green plant. An airy morning setting different from the first clip.
clips.presenter: A fictional adult Vietnamese man about 32 years old, short neat black hair, thin round glasses, clean-shaven, wearing an ivory polo shirt. Relaxed friendly smile, positioned behind the island to the left of the kettle, waist-up view. Product foreground remains the main subject.
